analyst.summary: Escorts Kubota delivered a record FY26 (revenue +12.6%, EBITDA +28.5%, continuing-ops PAT +24.4%) on strong tractor volumes, but the widely-quoted '92% PAT growth' figure is inflated by a one-time ~Rs1,600cr gain from divesting the Railway Equipment business (to Sona BLW) - the clean, comparable earnings growth is +24.4%, still strong but not the headline number. At ~Rs2,940/share (~Rs32,892cr market cap), the stock trades at ~15.5x headline trailing P/E, but a cleaner ~23-24x on recurring continuing-operations earnings looks rich against management's own FY27 guidance of a flat-to-down tractor industry (high base effect, El Nino risk, wage/input cost pressure) and mid-teens (not premium-multiple-justifying) return ratios. Balance sheet is debt-free and capital allocation (the divestment itself) has been sound; a pending, disputed FIR against the CMD (unrelated to financials) is a reputational item to monitor, not a financial red flag today.
